purpose: Teach: オマケ/脳みそ/右肩/負け犬/ペースト/方角/かわし/ひきこもり

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオマケ付きのお菓子を買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought you some snacks with little toys in them.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Soft smile in the voice. The tone of a mother sharing a small gift of news. Light and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが「脳みそ柔らかく」って仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me to keep my mind flexible.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick tempo. Sho's excitement at having something to report—a little proud of the wisdom he's been given. Direct eye contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが右肩を痛められたみたい
lines.en: Sho, it sounds like your dad hurt his right shoulder.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. A slight pause before 'hurt'—she's piecing something together. Not alarmed, but attentive. The voice of a mother noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、負け犬扱いされたくないって思うよ
lines.en: Mom, I don't want people to think of me as a loser.
lines.style: Quiet intensity beneath the surface. Sho's voice is steady but there's weight to it—this matters to him more than the casual phrasing suggests. Small, serious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがペースト状のお薬を飲んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has been taking some medicine in paste form.
lines.style: Gentle, factual delivery. Yumiko is offering information carefully—not hiding it, but not dramatizing it either. The tone of a mother being honest.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと方角を確認して進んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I checked the direction before we went.
lines.style: Bright report. Sho's voice is clear and satisfied—he did something important with his dad. There's pride in the small responsibility he carried out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがボールをかわしながら遊んで下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad played with you, dodging the ball the whole time.
lines.style: Warm, approving tone. A quiet pleasure in Yumiko's voice at what her husband did despite his shoulder. The slight lift of admiration for his effort.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ひきこもりになりたくないって誓うよ
lines.en: Mom, I promise I don't want to become a shut-in.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Sho's voice is small but resolute—this is a vow he's making to himself as much as to her. Slightly serious, grounded.
